# Pull Request

## Summary

## Scope

- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] UI change
- [ ] Database or intelligence data change
- [ ] Build, tooling, or test change
- [ ] Security, privacy, or OPSEC relevant change

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npx vitest run`
- [ ] `npm run security:scan`
- [ ] `npm run a11y` when UI or accessibility behavior changed
- [ ] Manual review completed

## Security and OPSEC Review

- [ ] No real investigation data, credentials, or private identifiers are included.
- [ ] Data provenance and licensing are documented where relevant.
- [ ] Offline-first behavior is preserved or the exception is documented.
- [ ] Abuse potential and privacy impact were considered.
- [ ] CSP rules were respected: no inline scripts, styles, handlers or new origins.
- [ ] `.env` files, credentials and `node_modules/` are not staged.
